entities.summary: Roelof Frederik Botha is a South African-American venture capitalist. He served as the managing partner of Sequoia Capital from 2022 to 2025. He joined the firm in 2003 as a partner, later taking over their U.S. and European early-stage investment franchises in 2017. Botha was the chief financial officer (CFO) of PayPal from 2000 to 2003, taking the company public in 2002.
